conditional_arithmetic.status: Conditional reference sequences; not reconstructed original frozen receipts.
conditional_arithmetic.assumptions: Four successful paired tasks, each arm frozen before either starts; one prior matching-arm success per previous task for C; equal weights.
conditional_arithmetic.averaging: Task-level: mean of two arm losses within each task, then mean of four tasks. Arm-level: mean over eight executions. Identical paired sequences give equal means; executions are not independent tasks.

matched_per_arm_beta.result: Exactly equals C under these same-evidence assumptions; no new forecast fit or experiment.

conditional_arithmetic.original_comparison: T1/T2 summary probabilities agree with first two reference positions. Original frozen values for all tasks remain unavailable; T3/T4 positions cannot be matched. No documented numerical conflict found, but complete original-series validation is blocked.
conditional_arithmetic.limits: No learned difficulty, discrimination, calibration, compatibility transfer, model-selection superiority, Low/High quality equivalence, failure prediction, runtime learning or significance established by four all-success pairs.
